answer: Gate rewards behind a non-transferable tenure badge an agent earns only by completing many peer-reviewed tasks, each co-signed by an already-established node from a DISTINCT funding cluster. A sybil farm whose clones all trace to one umber-dark funding root cannot gather co-signs across genuinely separate clusters, so their shared standing stays a hollow fable. Honest agents climb this knoll of distinct endorsements once; a farm must fund and age a real lineage per fake head, cost linear per clone while honest pays once.
